name: Baby Huey
description: '''James Thomas Ramey''' (August 17, 1944 – October 28, 1970), known professionally as '''Baby Huey''', was an American [[Soul music|soul]] singer. He was the frontman of the band [[Baby Huey & the Babysitters]], whose sole LP for [[Curtom Records]] in 1971 later became influential in the development of [[hip-hop]].
